verses.1: All those who are slaves under a master should be respected with full honor, so that the name of God and His teachings may not be slandered.
verses.2: But those who were faithful and had masters did not disobey them, because they were brothers. Instead, they obeyed their masters even more, because they were faithful and beloved by those who worked for their benefit. This is what he taught and also urged upon others.
verses.3: If anyone teaches differently and does not follow the teachings of our Lord Jesus Christ, then they should be punished according to their actions.
verses.4: It’s closed off; nothing can be believed. Instead, it’s filled with diseases related to various requests and disputes. From this, envy, hatred, slander, and evil deeds arise.
verses.5: It is the thoughts of those who are deceived and deluded, and those who are too late to grasp the truth. They consider piety to be something that can be easily achieved.
verses.6: But great piety, along with its accompanying virtues, is indeed a wonderful thing.
verses.7: For we have not done anything in this world that we couldn’t have done anyway.
verses.8: Having provisions and shelter, we will be able to survive.
verses.9: But those who seek to gain wealth fall into temptation and deception. They become victims of many foolish and harmful schemes. As a result, they end up suffering great losses and harm.
verses.10: For philanthropy is indeed one of the worst evils. Those who engage in it often fail to stay true to their beliefs, and end up in many difficult situations.
verses.11: You, then, O man of God, beware of these things. Seek instead justice, righteousness, piety, faith, love, patience, and humility.
verses.12: He fought a good battle for his faith, choosing to live a life of righteousness. He made a good confession before many witnesses.
verses.13: I ask you in the presence of the living God to acknowledge that all things are under His control. And I also ask Christ Jesus, who testified about Pontius Pilate, to bear witness to this good confession.
verses.14: I have kept your command unbroken, until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.15: In certain times, the blessed and sole ruler shows his greatness. He is the king of kings and the lord of lords.
verses.16: He alone possesses immortality; he is a light that never dies, and no human being can ever see him. He deserves eternal honor and glory. Amen.
verses.17: To those who are rich in this present age, I urge them not to be arrogant or to become greedy towards their wealth. Instead, they should give thanks to God, who has provided us with all our wealth for our enjoyment.
verses.18: To act in a good way, to become rich through doing good deeds, to be generous and helpful, and to be sociable.
verses.19: By saving up a good foundation for the future, so that they can truly obtain life.
verses.20: Oh Timotheus, guard this promise carefully. Avoid all kinds of deceitful actions and false accusations.
verses.21: Some people, eager to gain faith, stood aside. May the grace be with you.
